<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 Da, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈140.108 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1) indicates about eight carbon atoms. The formula C₈H₁₂O₂ matches this mass (140.0837 Da) and the observed isotopic distribution closely, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H12O2</final_answer>
